intro_en: FullStack Bench is ByteDance Seed Foundation Code Team's bilingual, multilingual full-stack coding benchmark. Its 3,374 problems span 16 programming languages and 11 mainstream application domains with 15,168 unit tests; SandboxFusion extracts, synthesizes, and executes model code for Pass@1 scoring.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.00535 Sections 2–3. GitHub snippets, code documents/books, XLCoST, and expert-authored domain questions are converted into instructions, reference solutions, language-specific tests, and labels with LLM assistance and human verification. Annotators check difficulty, ambiguity, and solvability, cross-refine each other's work, and resolve disagreement by consensus or senior adjudication. Six-model voting filters items solved by all models and labels difficulty. A 500K-question Stack Overflow analysis yields 11 mainstream domains plus Others. The bilingual release contains 3,374 problems across 16 programming languages and 15,168 unit tests. SandboxFusion extracts model code, combines tests, executes it, and reports Pass@1.
